text_block_list.name: Troubled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: So, I made a carrot pie for my little sister, but she got mad at me, saying she wanted them raw.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... That's so sad.
Even though you worked so hard making it for your sister.
I'm sure your feelings still reached her, though.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(It's getting late... We should wrap this up soon.
Though there are still so many girls
whose worries I haven't heard yet—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! It's already getting late today...
So everyone else, send me your worries on LANE, okay?
I promise I'll reply to every single one of you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Acting as a sanctuary for troubled Umamusume,
she listened to every single concern brought to her,
ending up staying up late into the night.
